programs.name: 1982 Pad
programs.description: A dark saw foundation supports a later pulse glow, a broad stereo field, chorus and a faint slow ring beat. A very slow ring-modulator movement shades the sustained chord.

programs.name: Sweep VCA
programs.description: A warm body and brighter pulse rank share gentle 3.8 Hz SUB amplitude motion. The circuit tremolo adds stereo movement while the whole chord rises and falls smoothly without chopping to silence. A slower main entrance and longer ending, preserving the source's brief accents.

programs.name: Blade Choir

programs.name: Amber Pads 47

programs.name: Velvet Pads 48

programs.name: Distant Pads 49

programs.name: Neon Pads 50

programs.name: Hollow Pads 51

programs.name: Golden Pads 52

programs.name: Frozen Pads 53

programs.name: Electric Pads 54
